intro_en: You will learn to explain what a dzud is, name its types (white, black, iron), and describe a harsh winter using past tenses. You will also review the Mongolian past forms -сан and the evidential -жээ/-чээ, and the English past tenses.
intro_mn: Та зуд гэж юу болохыг тайлбарлах, зудын төрлүүдийг (цагаан, хар, төмөр) нэрлэх, хатуу өвлийг өнгөрсөн цагаар өгүүлэх талаар сурна. Мөн англи хэлний өнгөрсөн цагийн хэлбэрүүдийг (Past Simple, Past Continuous, Past Perfect) давтана.

vocab.example_en: When a dzud happens, a lot of livestock die.
Thick snow fell in the countryside.
The pasture was buried under snow, so there was none left.

vocab.example_mn: Цагаан зудын үед мал идшээ олдоггүй.
vocab.example_en: In a white dzud, animals cannot find food.

vocab.example_mn: Хар зудын үед ус, ногоо хомсдоно.
vocab.example_en: In a black dzud, water and grass become scarce.

vocab.example_mn: Төмөр зуд болоход газар мөсөн хучилттай болно.
vocab.example_en: In an iron dzud, the ground gets covered with ice.

sentences.mn: Зуд гэдэг бол хатуу өвлийн гамшиг юм.
sentences.en: A dzud is a disaster caused by a harsh winter.
alt_en: Dzud means a severe winter disaster.
sentences.mn_latin: Zud gedeg bol khatuu övliin gamshig yum.

sentences.mn: Цагаан зудын үед цас зузаан орно.
sentences.en: In a white dzud, heavy snow falls.
alt_mn: Цагаан зудын үед зузаан цас ордог.
alt_en: During a white dzud, the snow is thick.
sentences.mn_latin: Tsagaan zudyn üyed tsas zuzaan orno.

sentences.mn: Хар зудын үед цас орохгүй, мал уух ус ч олдохгүй.
sentences.en: In a black dzud there is no snow, and animals can't even find water.
alt_en: During a black dzud, no snow falls and the animals can't find water.
sentences.mn_latin: Khar zudyn üyed tsas orokhgüi, mal uukh us ch oldokhgüi.

sentences.mn: Төмөр зуд болоход бэлчээр мөсөн хучилттай болдог.
sentences.en: In an iron dzud, the pasture gets covered with a crust of ice.
alt_en: When an iron dzud hits, the pasture becomes covered in ice.
sentences.mn_latin: Tömör zud bolokhod belcheer mösön khuchilttai boldog.

sentences.mn: Өнгөрсөн өвөл маш их цас орсон.
sentences.en: Last winter a huge amount of snow fell.
alt_mn: Өнгөрсөн өвөл асар их цас орсон.
alt_en: Last winter it snowed a great deal.
sentences.mn_latin: Öngörsön övöl mash ikh tsas orson.

sentences.en: Apparently the cold reached minus thirty degrees.
alt_mn: Хүйтэн хасах гучин градуст хүрсэн байна.
alt_en: It turns out the temperature dropped to minus thirty.

sentences.mn: Бэлчээр цасанд булагдсан тул мал идэх юмгүй болсон.
sentences.en: The pasture was buried in snow, so the animals had nothing to eat.
alt_en: Because the pasture was buried under snow, the livestock had nothing left to eat.
sentences.mn_latin: Belcheer tsasand bulagdsan tul mal idekh yumgüi bolson.

sentences.mn: Манай нутагт олон мянган мал үхжээ.
sentences.en: In my home region, it seems thousands of animals died.
alt_mn: Манай нутагт олон мянган мал үхсэн байна.
alt_en: I hear thousands of animals died in my home region.
sentences.mn_latin: Manai nutagt olon myangan mal ükhjee.

sentences.mn: Малчид хужир, тэжээл хайж явсан ч олсонгүй.
sentences.en: The herders went looking for salty soil and fodder, but they didn't find any.
alt_en: The herders were searching for fodder and salt-lick ground, but found none.
sentences.mn_latin: Malchid khujir, tejeel khaij yavsan ch olsongüi.

sentences.mn: Бид ирэхэд нэг айлын бүх хонь үхчихсэн байсан.
sentences.en: When we arrived, all of one family's sheep had already died.
alt_en: By the time we arrived, one family had lost all its sheep.
sentences.mn_latin: Bid irekhed neg ailyn bükh khoni ükhchikhsen baisan.

sentences.en: Many herders moved to the city.
alt_mn: Олон малчин хот руу нүүж ирсэн.
alt_en: Many herders relocated to the city.

sentences.mn: Тэр зун бэлчээр муу байсан тул мал турсан байсан.
sentences.en: The pasture had been poor that summer, so the animals were already thin.
alt_en: The animals had grown thin because the pasture was poor that summer.
sentences.mn_latin: Ter zun belcheer muu baisan tul mal tursan baisan.

grammar.title_mn: Өнгөрсөн цагийн хэлбэрүүд: Past Simple, Past Continuous, Past Perfect
grammar.explain_en: To tell a story about a bad winter, use -сан/-сэн/-сон/-сөн (or -лаа/-лээ/-лоо/-лөө) for events you know directly: «Цас орсон» (Snow fell). Use -жээ/-чээ when you learn something by seeing the result or hearing about it, often with surprise: «Мал үхжээ» (Apparently the animals died). «-сан байна» is a common alternative for reports. For background that came before another past event, use «-сан байсан»: «Мал турсан байсан» (The animals had grown thin).
grammar.explain_mn: Англи хэлэнд гамшгийг өгүүлэхдээ Past Simple-ийг үйл явдлын дарааллыг хэлэхэд хэрэглэнэ: «Heavy snow fell, and the animals died.» Past Continuous нь үйл явдлын дэвсгэрийг харуулна: «It was snowing heavily.» Past Perfect нь өөр өнгөрсөн үйлээс өмнө болсныг хэлнэ: «The animals had already grown thin.» Англи хэлэнд -жээ/-чээ шиг тусгай нөхцөл байхгүй, тиймээс «apparently», «it turns out», «I heard» гэх үгсээр илэрхийлнэ.

examples.mn: Өвөл хүйтэн байсан, цас зузаан орсон.
examples.en: The winter was cold and thick snow fell.
examples.mn_latin: Övöl khüiten baisan, tsas zuzaan orson.

examples.en: Apparently many animals died in the region.
When we got there, the animals had grown thin.

examples.mn: Цас орж байхад малчид бэлчээр хайж явсан.
examples.en: While it was snowing, the herders were looking for pasture.
examples.mn_latin: Tsas orj baikhad malchid belcheer khaij yavsan.

fill_blank.text: Өнгөрсөн өвөл маш их цас орс___.
fill_blank.translation: A huge amount of snow fell last winter.
fill_blank.explain_en: Past suffix -сан has vowel harmony: орох → орсон (back rounded vowel о).

fill_blank.text: Хонины сүрэг бүгд үх___! Би итгэж чадахгүй байна.
fill_blank.translation: The whole flock of sheep died! I can't believe it.
fill_blank.explain_en: -жээ shows surprise upon discovering the result.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Үр дүнг гэнэт олж харсан гайхшралыг -жээ илэрхийлнэ.

fill_blank.text: ___ зуд болоход газар мөсөн хучилттай болдог.
fill_blank.translation: In an iron dzud, the ground gets covered with ice.
fill_blank.explain_en: The iron dzud is the type with an ice crust.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Мөсөн хучилттай болгодог зуд бол төмөр зуд.

fill_blank.text: When we arrived, the animals ___ already died.
fill_blank.translation: Бид очиход мал аль хэдийн үхсэн байсан.
fill_blank.explain_en: Past perfect (had + past participle) shows an action before another past action.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Өөр өнгөрсөн үйлээс өмнө болсныг Past Perfect (had + V3) илэрхийлнэ.

fill_blank.text: Last night it ___ heavily, and by morning the pasture was white.
fill_blank.translation: Өчигдөр шөнө их цас орж, өглөө болоход бэлчээр цагаан болсон байв.
fill_blank.explain_en: A completed event in the past uses the simple past: «snowed».
fill_blank.explain_mn: Дууссан үйл явдалд Past Simple («snowed») тохиромжтой.

fill_blank.text: The herders ___ for fodder when the storm hit.
fill_blank.translation: Шуурга болоход малчид тэжээл хайж байсан.
fill_blank.explain_en: Past continuous describes an action in progress when another event interrupted.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Өөр үйл явдал тохиход үргэлжилж байсан үйлийг Past Continuous (were looking) хэлнэ.

dialogue.speaker: Эмма
dialogue.mn: Болд, зуд гэж яг юу вэ? Мэдээнээс сонслоо.
dialogue.en: Bold, what exactly is a dzud? I heard it on the news.
dialogue.mn_latin: Bold, zud gej yag yuu ve? Medeenees sonsloo.

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.mn: Зуд бол хатуу өвлийн улмаас мал их үхдэг гамшиг юм.
dialogue.en: A dzud is a disaster where many livestock die because of a harsh winter.
dialogue.mn_latin: Zud bol khatuu övliin ulmaas mal ikh ükhdeg gamshig yum.

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.mn: Тийм. Цагаан зуд цастай, хар зуд цасгүй, төмөр зуд мөстэй байдаг.
dialogue.en: Yes. White dzud has heavy snow, black dzud has no snow, and iron dzud has ice.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tiim. Tsagaan zud tsastai, khar zud tsasgüi, tömör zud möstei baidag.

dialogue.speaker: Эмма
dialogue.mn: Чиний гэр бүл үүнийг амссан уу?
dialogue.en: Did your family go through one?
dialogue.mn_latin: Chinii ger bül üüniig amssan uu?

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.mn: Тийм ээ, 2010 онд өвөө маань зуун гаруй хонио алдсан.
dialogue.en: Yes, in 2010 my grandfather lost over a hundred sheep.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tiim ee, 2010 ond övöö maani zuun garui khonio aldsan.

dialogue.speaker: Эмма
dialogue.en: That's terrible. What happened to the pasture?

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.mn: Цасанд булагдсан тул мал идэх юмгүй болсон.
dialogue.en: It was buried in snow, so the animals had nothing to eat.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tsasand bulagdsan tul mal idekh yumgüi bolson.

culture_note.en: Dzud is one of the biggest threats to Mongolian herders; severe ones, like in 1999–2002 and 2009–2010, killed millions of animals. Many families lost their livelihood and moved to Ulaanbaatar's ger districts. Today herders try to prepare by storing hay and fodder and buying insurance.
culture_note.mn: Зуд бол монгол малчдад тулгардаг хамгийн том аюулуудын нэг. 1999–2002, 2009–2010 оны хүнд зудад олон сая мал хорогдсон. Олон өрх амьжиргаагаа алдаж, Улаанбаатарын гэр хороолол руу нүүсэн. Одоо малчид тэжээл, өвс бэлтгэж, малаа даатгуулахыг хичээдэг.

review.notes: Content is good and relevant, but there are several case-ending errors (genitive before үед, dative with хүрэх), a mismatched grammar title and intro, and one ambiguous English fill-in-the-blank.

opus_fix.notes: Mostly solid; fixed a wrong verb stem and options in one blank, the хужир verb, a few harmony variants, and wording.

changes.why: Animals lick salt-lick ground (долоох); иддэг means 'eat' and does not match the English 'lick'
'Манай нутаг' is the natural way to say 'my home region'
-ав is not explained anywhere; the explanation uses -лаа
The stem is үх-; 'үхэ' + жээ gives the wrong form 'үхэжээ'
Options must use front-vowel harmony; 'сэн' would also be correct and is removed so only one answer fits
'Шөнөжин' means 'all night', but the English says 'last night'
